large_unit: separate survival, productive-window, and completion-envelope decision predicates for terminal classification

terminal_predicates.survival_pass: elapsed>=1200 AND no duration-attributable forced stop
terminal_predicates.productive_evidence: goal-directed W6 work sustained across invocation with unit/timestamp evidence
terminal_predicates.completion_pass: durable close saved after target and scheduler prearm remained valid
terminal_predicates.strict_case_state: CLEAN_PASS_PENDING_WAKE only if all three are satisfied; next wake promotes SAFE_LOWER_BOUND
terminal_predicates.duration_fail_candidate: credible forced stop before clean target close with non-duration causes excluded

policy_implication: Do not promote HARD_CAP=20m or PRODUCTIVE_CAP from survival alone; 20m must close and wake cleanly first, then later replication determines operating cap.
